SELECT id, name, category_id FROM sub_categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY display_order ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT id, name, display_order, category_id, is_default FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, display_order, category_id, is_default FROM sub_categories WHERE category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}) AND display_order >= (SELECT display_order FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}) AND is_default = false ORDER BY display_order ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, name, display_order, category_id, is_default FROM sub_categories WHERE category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}) AND display_order <= (SELECT display_order FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}) AND is_default = false ORDER BY display_order DESC LIMIT #{limit}
